title: Week 9 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “delinquency”?
options: Failure to make a required payment on time.
Readily accessible funds available for near-term needs.
Assets minus liabilities at a point in time.
Capacity to absorb shocks and continue meeting essential obligations.
questions.explanation: Delinquency means failure to make a required payment on time.
choices: Failure to make a required payment on time.
Readily accessible funds available for near-term needs.
Assets minus liabilities at a point in time.
Capacity to absorb shocks and continue meeting essential obligations.

Nonwage compensation such as insurance, retirement contribution, leave, or tuition support.
